title: Returned Bank Payouts and the Bank Return Keep-Back, Pocketwire Business Profile
content:
**Rule of the payouts risk team.** The bank return keep-back on a Pocketwire Business Profile is 600.00 dollars when at least 2 returns of standard bank payouts are dated within the rolling 6 months ending on the handling date, 250.00 dollars when at least one but fewer than 2 are, and nothing when none is. A rolling window of a number of months ending on the handling date covers the dates after the same calendar day that many months earlier, up to and including the handling date.

| Returns of standard bank payouts dated in the rolling 6 months | Bank return keep-back |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | USD 600.00 |
| exactly 1 | USD 250.00 |
| none | none |

Only returns of standard bank payouts count; the return of an instant payout to a debit card does not.

**Case (hypothetical, handling date 20 September).** A bank payout returned on 21 March counts (the window covers the dates after 20 March); one returned on 20 March does not.
